item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00362","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C06","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It uses virtually the same operative sentence and administrative machinery as the child: the identical categories of tax returns and 1945–1957 period, the Eighty-fifth Congress, authorization of a Senate committee or subcommittee, an investigation established by a numbered Senate resolution agreed to on January 30, 1957, compliance with Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, and effectiveness upon Federal Register filing. The child principally substitutes the Senate Committee on the Judiciary and its internal-security investigation for C04's select committee and labor-management investigation. C06 is also extremely close in dates and machinery, while C08 is especially relevant because it concerns the same Senate Committee on the Judiciary and resolution-based investigative authority, but both are slightly less complete matches.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return, for the years 1945 to 1957, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-fifth Congress, be open to inspection","parent_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return, for the years 1945 to 1957, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-fifth Congress, be open to inspection","explanation":"The central grant of inspection authority is reproduced essentially verbatim, including the precise tax categories, years, and Congress."},{"child_excerpt":"pursuant to Senate Resolution 58, 85th Congress, agreed to January 30, 1957","parent_excerpt":"established by Senate Resolution 74, 85th Congress, agreed to January 30, 1957","explanation":"Both adapt the same resolution-based mechanism and syntactic slot to a different Senate investigation."},{"child_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133","parent_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133","explanation":"The governing administrative machinery is identical."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","explanation":"The concluding effectiveness clause differs only by the immaterial omission of “become.”"}]}
